Validity of appointments as Income-tax Officer of Assistant Income tax Officers and of proceedings taken by them

THE INCOME TAX PROCEEDINGS VALIDITY ORDINANCE, 1943
THE INCOME‑TAX
PROCEEDINGS VALIDITY ORDINANCE, 1943.
ORDINANCE No. IV
of 1943
[16th January,
1943]
An Ordinance to establish the validity of certain
appointments as Income‑tax Officer of, and certain proceedings under the
Income tax Act, 1922, taken by, persons designated as Assistant Income tax
Officers.
WIIEREAS an emergency has arisen
which makes it necessary to establish the validity of certain appointments as
Income‑tax Officer of, and certain proceedings under the Income‑tax
Act, x 1922, taken by, persons designated as Assistant Income‑tax is
Officers;
Now, THEREFORE, in exercise of
the powers conferred by sec tion 72 of the Government of India Act, as set out
in the 26 Ninth Schedule to the Government of India Act, 1935, the G Governor‑General
is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:--- 26 Geo 5,c.2.
2. Validity of appointments as
Income-tax Officer of Assistant Income tax Officers and of proceedings taken by
them------Where, whether before or after the commencement of this Ordinance,
any person designated as an Assistant Income tax Officer has been appointed to
be or to discharge the functions of an Income‑tax Officer for any of the
purposes of the Income tax Act, 1922, and where, whether before or after the
commencement of this Ordinance, a person designated as an Assistant 19: Income‑tax
Officer, appointed to be or to discharge the functions of an Income‑tax
Officer, has given or served any notice or taken any action whatsoever under
the said Act for the purpose of or in connection with the making of an
assessment under the said Act, such person shall be deemed to be and always to
have been validly appointed as an Income‑tax Officer for the purposes of
the said Act, and no act purporting to have been done by such person as an Income‑tax
Officer, and no notice purporting to have been given or served by such person
as an Income‑tax Officer shall be called in question merely on the ground
of any irregularity or defect in the manner of his appointment as an Income‑tax
Officer.
